parameters.name: ApiId
parameters.description:
The API data source ID, which is the **API ID**. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **API ID** of the API data source on the **Data Analytics** > **Data Collection** > **Data Source** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<props="china">For more information about API data sources, see [Configure an API data source](~~307003~~).</props>

parameters.name: ContentList
parameters.description:
The data content to be uploaded to IoT Platform in batches, in JSON list format.
- The number of JSON objects in the JSON list cannot exceed 100.
- The JSON must contain the **ts** field, which indicates the point in time when the data is generated (a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
